# NHCX Other

> Every page of the NHCX Other module of the ABDM Developer Portal, fetchable as markdown.

## Pages

- [Other](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other): The Other calls on NHCX: what each one does, the hosts they go to, and the guides that use them.
- [Task callback (internal variant) (adapter)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-internal-v1-task-on-submit): Internal twin of /v1/task/on_submit (hcxOnTaskPostInternal): the payer Task bundle wrapping the ClaimResponse outcome of a reprocess or cancel.
- [Task submit (internal variant) (adapter)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-internal-v1-task-submit): Internal twin of /v1/task/submit on the taskhcxservice, operationId hcxTaskPostInternal, with the same JWEPayload Task body and 202 envelope.
- [Swagger resources list](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-swagger-resources): Lists the Swagger resources (API document locations) exposed by the status service; used by Swagger UI, not by integrations.
- [Swagger security configuration](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-swagger-resources-configuration-security): Returns the Swagger UI security configuration for the status service; consumed by Swagger UI, not by integrations.
- [Swagger UI configuration](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-swagger-resources-configuration-ui): Returns the Swagger UI display configuration for the status service; consumed by Swagger UI, not by integrations.
- [Delete records (troubleshooting)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-delete): Internal troubleshooting operation on the claim service that deletes records by correlationid and action; not part of the business transaction flows.
- [Error report (callback)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-error): Where the exchange tells a sender that a request could not be delivered after five attempts. Received by every participant under its registered address. There i
- [Notification on_subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-notification-on-subscribe): BSP-side subscription acknowledgement; the same name denotes the callback where NHCX pushes claim-event notifications for a subscribed ABHA id.
- [Notification subscribe](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-notification-subscribe): A Beneficiary Service Provider (PHR app) subscribes an ABHA id to notification topics; NHCX persists it synchronously, Last-Linked-Wins per ABHA id.
- [Status callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-on-status): The answer to a status request, delivered to the sender that asked. The `x-hcx-status` in the protected header says where the message you asked about got to. Th
- [Task callback (reprocess or cancel outcome)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-task-on-submit): Payer returns a Task bundle with Task.status completed whose Task.output references a ClaimResponse carrying the reprocess or cancellation outcome.
- [Task submit (reprocess or cancel)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v1-task-submit): Provider sends a FHIR Task asking the payer to reprocess a rejected or short-paid claim or to cancel a preauth; Task.code and reasonCode set the intent.
- [Swagger 2 document (status service)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v2-api-docs): Serves the status service's Swagger 2 document, optionally filtered by a group query parameter; a discovery endpoint, not a protocol API.
- [OpenAPI 3 document (status service)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-v3-api-docs): Serves the status service's OpenAPI 3 document, optionally filtered by a group query parameter; a discovery endpoint, not a protocol API.
- [Receive error report (callback)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-error): Hosted by every participant. The exchange posts this message to the `endpoint_url` you registered, at `/v1/error`, with the headers and the sealed payload the s
- [Receive status callback](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-on-status): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the `endpoint_url` you registered, at `/v1/on_status`, with the headers and the sealed payload the se
- [Receive task callback (reprocess or cancel outcome)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-task-on-submit): Hosted by the provider. The exchange posts this message to the `endpoint_url` you registered, at `/v1/task/on_submit`, with the headers and the sealed payload t
- [Receive task submit (reprocess or cancel)](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/endpoints/other-webhook-v1-task-submit): Hosted by the payer. The exchange posts this message to the `endpoint_url` you registered, at `/v1/task/submit`, with the headers and the sealed payload the sen
- [Other errors](https://nha-in.github.io/docs/pr-10/docs/nhcx/v1/api/other/errors): What Other returns when a call fails, and what to do about it.
